manifest_version.description: Must be exactly "2.0". v1 manifests are no longer accepted.

name.description: Plugin slug (lowercase, 2-50 chars). Accepts snake_case or kebab-case (production manifests use both).

description.description: Plugin description shown in marketplace. Soft target ~200 chars for catalog cards; hard ceiling 1000 chars for compliance plugins with long regulatory descriptions.

oneOf.description: Legacy nested-object shape used by a small number of plugins (excel_analyst). Migration to array-of-strings is tracked under V1_LEGACY_FIELDS.

permissions.description: Permission slugs (free-form strings constrained to identifier chars) OR legacy object shape. Canonical set: ['network','filesystem','database','data:read','data:write','config:read','config:write'].

items.description: Plugin-local path (mounted under /api/plugins/<name>/...). Must start with '/' and use only [a-zA-Z0-9_/.*-]

signature.description: Ed25519 hex signature, 64 bytes = 128 hex chars

signature_pq.description: ML-DSA-65 hex signature (optional in v2.0, mandatory in v2.1)

ui_bundle_hash.description: SHA-256 of compiled UI bundle (raw hex or 'sha256-<hex>' prefixed form, both accepted).

ui_chunks_hash.description: Per-chunk SHA-256 hashes for code-split ES bundles

settings_schema.description: Per-plugin JSON Schema for runtime settings UI

category.description: Plugin category slug for marketplace catalog. Canonical values include 'agent','tool','skill','feature','mcp' but production manifests use plugin-domain categories ('eval','ops','notifications','automotive', etc.) so the enum is not locked here.

sandbox_policy.description: Path (relative to plugin dir) to a sandbox blueprint YAML

dependencies.description: LEGACY field (Phase 339-02 — review/decide). Pre-v2 manifests used this as a Python-package dependency list (array of strings) OR as a {component: version} map (e.g., {'core': '>=1.0.0'}); superseded by pyproject.toml. Kept in schema to avoid silent data drop during the v1→v2 cutover.

has_routes.description: LEGACY field (Phase 339-02 — review/decide). Pre-v2 manifests used this as a hint that the plugin mounts FastAPI routes; superseded by the api_paths array.

env_vars.description: LEGACY field (Phase 339-02 — review/decide). Pre-v2 manifests used this to declare which env vars the plugin reads; superseded by settings_schema.

capabilities.description: LEGACY field (Phase 339-02 — review/decide). Free-form capability hints used by 1 plugin pre-v2.

plugin_settings.description: LEGACY field (Phase 339-02 — review/decide). Pre-v2 manifests used this for runtime settings; superseded by settings_schema.

then.description: F1.5: has_ui:true MUST carry ui_bundle_hash so core can verify the UI bundle against the signed allowlist. The 'ui' metadata block is optional — production plugins use either the nested ui object OR the top-level display_name/category fallback (resolved by workbench fallback chain).
